# GrandOrgue MCP

> Modern pipe organ console — MIDI bridge, organ control, sample set management for GrandOrgue.

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) — Full documentation (tools, API, config, architecture)
- [README.md](README.md) — Overview and quick start
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) — System architecture
- [docs/MCP_TOOLS.md](docs/MCP_TOOLS.md) — Tool reference
- [docs/MIDI_SETUP.md](docs/MIDI_SETUP.md) — MIDI configuration
- [docs/SAMPLE_SETS.md](docs/SAMPLE_SETS.md) — Sample set guide

## Quick start
```
just install        # Backend deps
just install-web    # Frontend deps
just web            # Launch everything
```

Ports: Backend :11010, Frontend :11011
